item.title: Nathan Lane Returns to Broadway: Death of a Salesman Revival Sells Out Previews
item.description:
Nathan Lane’s Triumphant Return to Broadway

Nathan Lane is once again commanding the stage, and audiences can’t get enough. The Tony Award-winning actor’s latest Broadway venture — a revival of Arthur Miller’s Death of a Salesman — has sold out its preview performances at the Winter Garden Theatre, with the official opening night now set for April 9, 2026.

Key Takeaways:

  • Nathan Lane and Laurie Metcalf star as Willy and Linda Loman
  • Previews began March 6 and sold out immediately
  • The production runs through June 14, 2026
  • Directed by Tony winner Joe Mantello
  • Features an original score by Pulitzer Prize winner Caroline Shaw

A Powerhouse Cast Brings Miller’s Masterpiece to Life

Lane and Laurie Metcalf, both Tony winners in their own right, lead the cast as Willy and Linda Loman. The supporting ensemble is equally impressive, featuring Christopher Abbott, Ben Ahlers, K. Todd Freeman, Jonathan Cake, John Drea, Michael Benjamin Washington, Tasha Lawrence, and Jake Silbermann.
